title: Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements, sampling methods and test methods for drinking water, including acceptable limits and permissible limits where an alternate source is unavailable.
chunk: IS 10500:2012 specifies requirements and methods of sampling and testing for drinking water and defines acceptable and permissible limits for specified quality parameters.

title: General Requirements for Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres
scope: Specifies general requirements associated with establishment and operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres recognized by BIS.
chunk: IS 15820 forms the basis for BIS recognition of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys — Determination of Fineness
scope: Referenced for determination of fineness of gold and gold alloys and associated marking requirements for standard gold bars.
chunk: IS 1417:2016 is referenced in the BIS framework for refineries seeking licensing to mark standard gold bars of 995 and 999 fineness.

title: Hallmarking Overview
scope: Provides an overview of the BIS hallmarking system for gold and silver jewellery and explains the roles of jewellers and Assaying and Hallmarking Centres.
chunk: BIS operates a hallmarking scheme for gold and silver jewellery through its network of recognized facilities and registered jewellers.

title: Hallmarking FAQ
scope: Provides answers to common consumer questions about hallmark components, HUID, invoices, hallmarking charges and verification.
important_facts: Hallmarking charges are charged per article rather than according to jewellery weight.
Consumers should obtain an authentic bill or invoice.
Consumers can verify HUID information using BIS Care.
chunk: The BIS Hallmarking FAQ explains HUID verification, hallmark components, consumer bills and hallmarking charges.

title: Jeweller Registration Procedure
scope: Explains the procedure for obtaining BIS registration to sell hallmarked gold and silver jewellery from a sales outlet.
chunk: The procedure describes how a jeweller can obtain BIS registration for selling hallmarked jewellery.

title: Hallmarking Charges
chunk: BIS information states hallmarking charges of Rs. 45 per gold article and Rs. 35 per silver article, with charges applied per article rather than according to weight.

title: Consumer Protection — Hallmarking
scope: Provides consumer guidance for verification and testing of hallmarked jewellery and explains mechanisms for addressing concerns about hallmark authenticity.
chunk: Consumers can verify hallmark information and use BIS mechanisms for testing and complaint resolution.

title: BIS Care App — HUID Verification
scope: The BIS Care application provides consumers with tools including HUID verification for hallmarked jewellery and verification of BIS licence details.
chunk: BIS Care provides HUID verification for hallmarked jewellery, licence verification, access to standards information and complaint functionality.

title: Packaging — Complete, Filled Transport Packages and Unit Loads — Dimensions of Rigid Rectangular Packages
scope: Specifies dimensions relating to rigid rectangular packages and unit loads.
chunk: IS 8470 covers dimensions of rigid rectangular transport packages and unit loads.

title: Textiles — Monoaxially Oriented High Density Polyethylene Tapes — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for monoaxially oriented high-density polyethylene tapes used in textile-related applications.
chunk: IS 6192 specifies requirements for monoaxially oriented high-density polyethylene tapes.

title: Methods of Micro-Biological, Colour Fastness and Microscopical Tests for Leather — Part 2: Colour Fastness to Water
scope: Specifies a test method for determining colour fastness of leather to water.
chunk: IS 6191 Part 2 specifies methods related to colour fastness testing of leather against water.

title: Tungsten Powder for Hardmetals — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for tungsten powder intended for hardmetal applications.
chunk: IS 8392 specifies requirements for tungsten powder intended for hardmetal applications.
